content4.content:
Collections are data structures that let you store and manage multiple values in one place. Dart offers three main types:
List – ordered group of items
Set – unordered group with unique items
Map – key-value pairs (like a dictionary)

row2: A shopping list – items are ordered, can repeat
row3: A guest list – names can't be repeated
row4: A phonebook – names (keys) mapped to numbers (values)

content29.content:
`List`: Ordered, allows duplicates → like a to-do list
`Set`: Unordered, no duplicates → like a unique guest list
`Map`: Key-value pairs → like a contact book
* Dart provides methods like `.add()`, `.remove()`, `.contains()`, `.forEach()` to manage collections
Choose the right collection based on your data's nature
